description: A single messy finance sheet contains an approved-budget table and, after three blank rows, a donor-receipts table with a different schema.

questions.question: What is the total approved FY 2025-26 budget in INR across all programme-district rows? Do not add the displayed TOTAL APPROVED row.
questions.trap: Adding the displayed total row double-counts the budget.

questions.question: How much donor receipt income in INR was credited for the Jal Jeevan Saathi programme?
questions.trap: The receipts table has different columns from the budget table.

questions.question: How many distinct Receipt IDs in the donor-receipts table have Donor Type exactly 'Foreign Grant'?
questions.trap: Counting budget rows or the receipts total row gives a wrong count.

questions.question: Which donor has the highest total receipt amount when all of that donor's receipt rows are combined?
questions.trap: Selecting the largest single receipt is not the same as ranking donor totals.

questions.question: What percentage of the total approved budget has been received across all donor receipts? Report 100 × total receipts / total approved budget, rounded to two decimals, and exclude both displayed total rows.
questions.trap: Using either displayed total in addition to detail rows double-counts.
